sermon.title: Civil Rulers
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God sets rulers in government as in the church. From Proverbs, Romans 13 and 2 Chronicles 19 he shows rulers must praise good, punish evildoers and judge without bribes or partiality. He weighs America’s actions by whether they protect families and children, and reads the Constitution’s preamble in light of Scripture.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Many statistics are spoken from memory and UNVERIFIED (72% of families harbor an addict, 60% divorced parents, 48% unwed births, 80% of congregations sinning, 10,500 military men assaulted in 2014, $240B foreign aid, $1T on illegal immigrants, 2M street kids, 6.3M abused, 621,000 molested, 88,000 alcohol deaths, 54% with STDs, 92M not seeking work). “Deuteronomy 24:22” is spoken for the justify-the-righteous verse (Deuteronomy 25:1). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Hillary Clinton characterized on abortion, Trump on schools, illegal immigrants, women in foxholes and homosexuality blamed for military assaults, “poor white trash” self-description. A private name (Mr. Barnes) appears only in the transcript.

faqs.question: Is an apostle an apostle 24 hours a day?
faqs.answer: No—only when God needs the function; otherwise he’s fixing the plumbing.

faqs.question: Who removes and sets up kings?
What is government for?
faqs.answer: Praising the good and executing wrath on evildoers who hurt others.

faqs.question: Is the Bible just a book of religion?
faqs.answer: He says it is a book of truth.

faqs.question: What is the key to the nation?
faqs.answer: The family—as the family goes, so goes the nation.

faqs.question: Is preaching against sin unmerciful?
faqs.answer: No—he says it’s merciful because it sets you free.

faqs.question: Is legal intoxication acceptable?
faqs.answer: No—intoxication by drugs or alcohol is sin.

faqs.question: What should a young couple buy first?
Is a strong military biblical?
faqs.answer: Yes—government is to protect the nation from aggressors.
